description.value: Origin Bakery is a 100% gluten-free bakery founded in 2009 and operated from a storefront on Victoria's Pandora Avenue, offering fresh breads, pastries, cakes, cookies, and a lunch menu including prepared sandwiches. It is one of the few dedicated gluten-free bakeries on Vancouver Island, making it a rare and welcome stop for touring cyclists with celiac disease or gluten sensitivities. The bakery also stocks a small selection of packaged specialty food items and delivers across Vancouver Island via electric-vehicle courier.
